summary: Iteration 44 — Frontend-only testing of (1) honest Spell-check Popover on Campaign editor + (2) mobile responsiveness of the landing-page interactive demo. All acceptance criteria verified live in the deployed preview against drip.tester@example.com. Spellcheck UI: toolbar button now displays an AMBER dot (bg-amber-400) + label 'Test spell-check' (no longer 'Spellcheck: Active', no emerald dot). Clicking opens `editor-spellcheck-popover` containing the words browser / red wavy underline / definately / Chrome / Edge / Safari / Firefox. Clicking `editor-spellcheck-insert-btn` inserts ' definately ' into the contentEditable; NO misleading 'your browser should underline it in red' toast fires. Visual contentEditable has spellcheck='true', lang='en', autocorrect='on'; HTML-mode textarea has spellcheck='true'. Helper text reads 'Spell-check is handled by your browser — click Test spell-check if you don't see red underlines.' (honest, no false claim). Mobile responsiveness: at 360 / 390 / 430px viewports the landing page does NOT overflow horizontally (scrollWidth == innerWidth, diff=0 at all three). At 390px the tab strip is horizontally scrollable (sw=1423 cw=382 flex-wrap=nowrap) and ALL 11 demo tabs (dashboard, campaigns, drip, lists, accounts, warmup, unibox, leads, dne, backup, subscription) render their respective `demo-panel-<id>` correctly. Mobile section header is visible (display=flex) and desktop sidebar is hidden (display=none) at 390px. Wide-table panels (Campaigns, Leads) contain inner .overflow-x-auto wrappers whose scrollWidth > clientWidth (Campaigns 720 > 330; Leads inner overflow confirmed) while the page itself stays at scrollWidth=innerWidth=390 (no page-level horizontal scroll). At 1440px desktop the sidebar IS visible (display=flex), mobile section header IS hidden (display=none), and the tab strip uses flex-wrap=wrap with sw=cw=1216 (no horizontal overflow). All 11 demo tabs were clicked at 1440px and the subscription panel was confirmed rendered (visual screenshot shows the active panel + Subscription highlighted in sidebar). The Drip-campaign editor uses the SAME RichTextEditor component (static-grep confirmed in iter-43) so the same spellcheck UI applies there. Backend smoke test skipped per main-agent instruction (testing_type: frontend only).
critical_code_review_comments: RichTextEditor.jsx is now ~1082 lines — past the 700-line soft cap. Tracked since iter-43; still not blocking but worth splitting toolbar / popovers / HTML-mode logic into sub-modules.
LiveDashboardDemo.jsx is ~1228 lines — same observation; consider splitting Panel_* components into their own files.
Spell-check insert button still uses document.execCommand('insertText', …) (deprecated). Fallback createTextNode path works; consider Selection/Range API in a follow-up.

Honest UX win: removed the false 'Spellcheck: Active' pulse and the misleading post-insert toast. The new Popover correctly tells the user that the absence of a red wavy underline means their browser setting is off — verified.
seed_data_creation: None. Campaign editor was opened via `create-campaign-btn` for spellcheck verification only — no campaign was saved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter-44 acceptance criteria verified in preview. Spellcheck Popover content + amber-dot button + 'definately' insertion + spellcheck/lang/autocorrect attrs all PASS on Campaign editor (RichTextEditor is shared with Drip Campaign Step composer + AdminBlogs per iter-43 grep). Mobile-overflow checks PASS at 360/390/430 (scrollWidth==innerWidth). Tab strip horizontally scrollable @390 (sw=1423 cw=382 nowrap) and wrapped @1440 (sw=cw=1216 wrap). Mobile section header visible @390 (md:hidden flex) and hidden @1440 (display=none); desktop sidebar inverse. All 11 demo panels render at both viewports. NOTE for next agent: when clicking tabs via Playwright at mobile widths, use page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"demo-tab-...\"]').click()") instead of locator.click(force=True) — the latter can mis-target due to coordinate calculation when the strip is scrolled, and inadvertently click the sticky 'Start Free Trial' nav button which routes to /register. Backend not tested per request.
